beats.name: THE HOOK
beats.vo: Most companies miss the obvious signal hiding in plain sight.
beats.visual: Centered text stays on the same paper page for the entire beat.
beats.text: MOST COMPANIES MISS THE OBVIOUS SIGNAL
beats.question: What obvious signal are they missing?
beats.reveal: The signal was visible before anyone acted.

beats.name: THE BACKGROUND
beats.vo: An overlooked decision changed the economics of the entire business.
beats.visual: Exactly the same centered text layout remains on screen with no new visual language.
beats.reveal: The decision changed the economics long before the consequences appeared.

beats.name: THE FALSE COMFORT
beats.vo: The strange part is that the original plan actually worked at first.
beats.visual: The same page, same type treatment, same scale, and same static framing.
beats.text: THE ORIGINAL PLAN WORKED AT FIRST
beats.question: Why did a working plan become a problem?
beats.reveal: The early success hid the weakness inside the plan.

beats.name: THE TURN
beats.vo: Then one competitor noticed an opening and moved faster.
beats.visual: Nothing changes except the sentence on the same centered page.
beats.reveal: But the competitor moved faster and turned the hidden weakness into an advantage.

beats.name: THE ESCALATION
beats.vo: Executives doubled down while customers quietly changed behavior.
beats.visual: The same static typography holds for five more seconds.
beats.question: How long can management ignore the change?
beats.reveal: The gap widened while the company protected the old behavior.

beats.name: THE WARNING
beats.vo: The warning appeared again, but nobody connected the separate clues.
beats.visual: No chart, footage, diagram, icon, or camera move is introduced.
beats.reveal: The same warning returned, but the separate clues were never combined.

beats.name: THE COST
beats.vo: Eventually the cost became larger than the benefit they protected.
beats.visual: The exact same composition continues with another sentence replacing the last one.
beats.text: THE COST BECAME LARGER THAN THE BENEFIT
beats.question: When does protecting the old benefit become irrational?
beats.reveal: The protected benefit became smaller than the cost of preserving it.

beats.name: THE PAYOFF
beats.vo: The answer was simple: they optimized the old game until it disappeared.
beats.visual: The same centered text finally holds to the end with no visual payoff.
beats.text: THEY OPTIMIZED THE OLD GAME UNTIL IT DISAPPEARED
beats.reveal: The answer was simple: optimizing the old game became the reason the game disappeared.
